description: agent_instruction_audit.py checks CANONICAL/PROJECT anchors with 'anchor.casefold() not in section.casefold()' against the raw file text. Anchors are multi-word phrases, so a line break inside one makes the check fail: reflowing AGENTS.md split 'not authorization' across two lines and produced 'project COMMIT-IDENTITY-001 semantics drifted; missing anchors: not authorization'. That message reads as a semantics change when nothing semantic changed, and it fires on exactly the edit the byte budget forces you to make - rewrapping to save space. Normalise whitespace on both sides before matching.
